app: Meta (Facebook Login for Business: Pages, Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp Business)
summary: Creating the app and testing with your own Page, Instagram account and WhatsApp number takes about an hour. To reach other businesses' accounts you need Advanced Access, and getting it is the slow part: Business Verification, App Review with one screencast and one written use case per permission, and for WhatsApp Embedded Signup also Tech Provider Access Verification. Plan for 2-8 weeks of calendar time. Each rejection restarts the review queue, and every connected Page has to reconnect before its token carries newly approved scopes.

verdict.launchNote: First token: 30-60 min (own Page/IG/WhatsApp test number, Standard Access, Development mode). 2-8 weeks from scratch (Business Verification + App Review + Access Verification, often one or more resubmissions); 1-4 weeks to add publishing scopes to an already verified, live app.
verdict.reviewRequired: App Review per permission for Advanced Access (screencast + written use case each), Business Verification of the app's business portfolio, and for WhatsApp Embedded Signup the Tech Provider Access Verification; afterwards an annual Data Use Checkup
verdict.costNote: free to register and review; WhatsApp conversations are billed per message to the client's WhatsApp Business Account (client adds a payment method)

evidence.note: Meta's official wait is 'a decision within a week' per submission; the 2-8 week range adds verification and the ~20-day per-cycle reviews reported by developers in 2026 (anecdotal).

testMode.limits: Standard Access, available without review, works only for people who hold a role on the app (admin/developer/tester) and on assets they manage. In Development mode the app can request permissions only from role users. Embedded Signup cannot be tested on localhost: it needs an allowlisted HTTPS domain. A Tech Provider cannot onboard its own business portfolio through Embedded Signup, so test with a separate test business.

evidence.note: The HTTPS-only and own-portfolio limits come from Iskaria's production app.

prerequisites.item: Meta developer account plus a business portfolio (formerly Business Manager) that owns the app. Required for apps that access data the developer does not own.
Privacy policy URL on the app (Basic Settings), live and reachable
Data deletion instructions URL or a data deletion callback URL (Basic Settings)

evidence.note: https://iskaria.com/data-deletion is live (2026-10-30). That is an instructions page, not a signed-request callback; either one satisfies the field.

prerequisites.item: App icon and category in Basic Settings (App Review checks app settings)

evidence.note: The required icon pixel size was not checked.

prerequisites.item: Business Verification of the business portfolio that owns the app: legal name, address, phone, website, and documents if Meta cannot match public records

evidence.note: Holding Advanced Access implies a verified business (inferred from Iskaria's production app, which holds Advanced Access).

prerequisites.item: Screencasts, one per requested permission (1080p or better, no audio needed)

evidence.note: Record new videos for each submission.

prerequisites.item: Each connected client Instagram account must be a professional (Business/Creator) account. On the Facebook Login path it must also be linked to the client's Facebook Page.
HTTPS domain allowlisted in the app (Allowed Domains for the JS SDK / Embedded Signup) and Valid OAuth Redirect URIs

evidence.note: Use your HTTPS app domain. An http://localhost redirect does not work for Embedded Signup.

steps.title: Create a Business app from use cases
steps.detail: Go to developers.facebook.com > My Apps > Create app. Pick the use cases you need (for example 'Manage everything on your Page', the Instagram messaging/content use case, and 'Connect with customers through WhatsApp'). Use cases cannot be removed later, and the dashboard greys out incompatible ones. When asked, connect the app to your business portfolio (verified or not yet verified).

fields.label: Business portfolio
fields.note: Required if the app touches data you don't own

evidence.note: Meta's create-an-app doc names 'Manage everything on your Page'. The exact Instagram and WhatsApp use-case labels were not confirmed in docs this session.

steps.title: Fill Basic Settings: URLs, icon, category, deletion
steps.detail: App settings > Basic: App domains, Privacy Policy URL, Terms of Service URL, User data deletion (instructions URL or callback URL), icon, category. An agent can prepare all values from the profile; a human pastes them in and saves.

fields.label: Terms of Service URL
fields.note: Confirm your terms URL is live before submitting

fields.label: User data deletion (Data deletion instructions URL)

steps.title: Configure Facebook Login for Business and redirect URIs
steps.detail: Add the Facebook Login for Business product. Create a configuration (its config_id) listing only the assets and permissions you need. Set Valid OAuth Redirect URIs (HTTPS) and, for the JS SDK and Embedded Signup, Allowed Domains with Enforce HTTPS on.

fields.label: Valid OAuth Redirect URIs
fields.note: Use your HTTPS production callback, not localhost

fields.label: Allowed Domains for the JavaScript SDK

steps.title: Test with your own assets under Standard Access
steps.detail: Log in as an app admin. Connect your own Page, IG professional account and WhatsApp test number, then call the Graph API: send a Messenger/IG reply, publish a test Page post, send a WhatsApp message. Add teammates as app testers; non-role users will fail.

steps.title: Complete Business Verification
steps.detail: Business portfolio > Security Center > Start verification. Enter the legal name, address, phone and website, and upload a registration or tax document if Meta can't match public records. Then confirm by email, phone or domain. The name must match the documents exactly.
steps.estimate: 30 min hands-on; days to ~4 weeks wait

evidence.note: The wait time is not documented by Meta; the 4-week figure comes from third-party help centres (anecdotal).

steps.title: Record one screencast per permission
steps.detail: For each permission, record at 1080p or better with no cuts. Start from the login and consent screen, then show the permission at work end to end: a reply arriving in Messenger/IG, a post visible on the Page, a published IG post, a WhatsApp message received in the WhatsApp client and a template created. Reviewers follow the video, so use the same test account you give them.

steps.title: Submit App Review for Advanced Access
steps.detail: App Review > Permissions and features: request Advanced Access per permission. Write a separate use-case description for each one (don't reuse text), upload its video, and explain in Platform Settings how reviewers can reach the app. An agent can draft the descriptions from useCases.meta; a human submits.
steps.estimate: 1-2 h hands-on; ~1 week official, ~20 days reported per cycle

steps.title: WhatsApp: become a Tech Provider (Access Verification) and enable Embedded Signup
steps.detail: After Business Verification and approval of whatsapp_business_messaging + whatsapp_business_management, complete Access Verification in the WhatsApp dashboard (shown as about 5 business days). Until all three are done, Embedded Signup onboards at most 10 new business customers per rolling 7 days; after them, 200. Test onboarding with a business portfolio other than the one that owns the app.
steps.estimate: 30 min hands-on; ~5 business days stated, often longer

steps.title: Switch the app to Live and have every Page reconnect
steps.detail: Set App Mode to Live. Each client then has to go through Facebook Login for Business again so their Page/IG token carries the newly approved scopes. Old tokens keep failing on publish calls with Graph error 10 or 200-299 until they reconnect. An agent can detect missing scopes (debug_token) and prompt each customer.

steps.title: Complete the annual Data Use Checkup
steps.detail: An app admin gets notified 60 days before the app's Data Use Checkup deadline. Review the permissions in use, answer the data-handling questions and certify compliance. Missing it risks losing API access. Keep admin contact details current.

scopes.name: pages_messaging
scopes.purpose: Read and reply to the connected Page's Messenger conversations

evidence.note: Tested on a real production app (Iskaria's live Meta app), which already holds this scope.

scopes.name: pages_manage_posts
scopes.purpose: Publish, edit and delete the connected Page's own posts
scopes.note: Depends on pages_read_engagement and pages_show_list. Without it, publish calls fail (Graph error 10 / 200-299) until Advanced Access is granted.

evidence.note: Tested on a real production app (Iskaria's live Meta app), which does not hold it yet: publish calls fail with Graph error 10 / 200-299.

scopes.name: pages_read_engagement
scopes.purpose: Read the Page's own posts and engagement; prerequisite for the posting and IG permissions

scopes.name: instagram_manage_messages
scopes.purpose: Read and reply to the connected account's Instagram Direct messages
scopes.note: Facebook Login path; needs instagram_basic, pages_read_engagement, pages_show_list. The Instagram Login path uses instagram_business_manage_messages instead and needs no linked Page.

scopes.name: instagram_content_publish
scopes.purpose: Publish the connected account's organic Instagram feed posts

evidence.note: Tested on a real production app (Iskaria's live Meta app), which does not hold it yet.

scopes.name: whatsapp_business_messaging
scopes.purpose: Send and receive WhatsApp messages, media and templates for the connected business number
scopes.note: Depends on whatsapp_business_management. Needed for the Tech Provider path. Review video must show a message sent from the app arriving in WhatsApp.

scopes.name: business_management
scopes.purpose: Read and manage the client's business portfolio assets (Pages, ad accounts, WABAs) via the Business Manager API
scopes.note: Request only if you truly manage portfolio assets; reviewers question it often.

evidence.note: Tested on a real production app (Iskaria's live Meta app), which already holds this scope.

blockers.title: Every rejection restarts the queue
blockers.detail: Meta reviews the whole submission in one pass. A broken privacy URL, test login, or a video that doesn't show the consent screen gets permissions rejected, and the resubmission waits the full cycle again. Developers report ~20 days per cycle in 2026; Meta's guide says about a week.
blockers.workaround: Verify the business first. Make sure the reviewer test path works. Record each video from login to visible result on the day you submit.

blockers.title: Business Verification rejected or stuck
blockers.detail: Advanced Access is impossible without Business Verification. A legal name that doesn't match the documents, or a website without the legal entity in its footer, is a common cause of rejection.
blockers.workaround: Fill legalEntity in the profile and make your website footer show the same legal name.

blockers.title: New scopes do not reach existing tokens
blockers.detail: After pages_manage_posts / instagram_content_publish are approved, each connected Page and IG account must reconnect through Facebook Login for Business. Until then publish calls fail with Graph error 10 or 200-299.
blockers.workaround: Check granted scopes per token and show a 'reconnect to enable posting' prompt.

blockers.title: Client WABA not verified blocks templates
blockers.detail: A client WhatsApp Business Account whose business verification sat at 'pending_submission' could not publish or send templates until the client verified their own business.
blockers.workaround: Make client business verification part of onboarding, with the client's own documents.

blockers.title: Embedded Signup: HTTPS only, not your own portfolio, 10 customers/week before verification
blockers.detail: Embedded Signup runs only on Allowed Domains with HTTPS, so localhost is out. The Tech Provider cannot onboard the portfolio that owns the app. Before Business Verification + App Review + Access Verification, the cap is 10 new customers per rolling 7 days; completing all three raises it automatically to 200, and more needs Meta Business Partner status.
blockers.workaround: Test on a preview HTTPS domain with a separate test business portfolio.

blockers.title: Access Verification can stall past its stated 5 business days
blockers.detail: In September-October 2026, developers reported Tech Provider Access Verification stuck 'In review' well past the 5 days shown, with support cases closed by an AI agent.

blockers.title: Missing the annual Data Use Checkup
blockers.detail: Live apps with Advanced Access must complete the Data Use Checkup by their deadline, or API access is at risk.
blockers.workaround: Keep at least two app admins with current emails.

agentCan: Prepare all Basic Settings values from the developer profile
Draft a distinct App Review use-case description per permission from useCases.meta
Write screencast scripts (login > consent > action > visible result) per permission
Implement Facebook Login for Business, the data deletion callback and webhook handlers
Detect tokens missing new scopes (debug_token) and prompt each customer to reconnect
Monitor Graph error codes 10 / 200-299 and surface 'needs review/reconnect'
youMust: Log in to the Meta developer dashboard and create the app (human Facebook account)
Submit Business Verification with legal documents
Record the screencasts and submit App Review
Switch the app to Live and complete the annual Data Use Checkup
Have each client verify their own business for WhatsApp templates

uncertainties: Review times: Meta says 'a decision within a week'; the ~20-day per-cycle figure and the 4-week Business Verification figure are anecdotal (2026 third-party posts).
Exact use-case labels in the 2026 app dashboard for Instagram and WhatsApp were not confirmed in official docs this session; only 'Manage everything on your Page' was.
Whether Business-type apps still show a Development/Live toggle in the use-case dashboard; Meta's app-modes page does not address Business apps specifically.
Whether holding Advanced Access always means the business portfolio is formally recorded as verified (inferred, not confirmed).
Meta's WhatsApp docs are moving to developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/...; some older /docs/whatsapp deep links may redirect or 404.

verification.claim: A data deletion callback is mandatory
verification.note: Either a callback URL or a deletion instructions URL satisfies the requirement. Iskaria's instructions page is enough.

verification.claim: App Review decision in about a week (Meta) vs ~20 days per cycle (developer reports)
verification.note: Meta: 'you should receive a decision within a week'. The 20-day figure is third-party only. If Meta cannot access the app, the entire submission is rejected; otherwise permissions are judged one by one.

verification.claim: OAuth endpoint behaviour (discovery metadata, PKCE, dynamic registration, unknown-client handling)
verification.note: Facebook's OIDC discovery only describes Limited Login (implicit id_token); no PKCE methods advertised, no dynamic registration. /v21.0/dialog/oauth with an unknown client_id returns HTTP 200 with an HTML error page.
